name: Jude
source: Jude’s an enigmatic, flamboyant being who has a knack for comedy and horror. His twisted sense of humor doesn’t gain him many allies, so why not be the first? Both teasing and morbidly unpredictable, his cryptic words and mannerisms thinly veil the carnival’s dark secrets.
